LESSON: GYMNASTICS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.2: Gymnastics
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Gymnastics, part of Performing and Displaying in Grade 4 CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: How does performance of rolls and balances improve body health?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch a virtual or live performance of crab balance and side roll,

2. demonstrate the crab balance,

3. demonstrate a side roll,

4. practise the crab balance while observing safety,

5. practise the side roll while observing safety,

6. combine a crab balance into a side roll in turns,

7. observe each other’s performance and give feedback.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch a virtual or live performance of crab balance and side roll,
2. demonstrate the crab balance,
3. demonstrate a side roll,
4. practise the crab balance while observing safety,
5. practise the side roll while observing safety,
6. combine a crab balance into a side roll in turns,
7. observe each other’s performance and give feedback.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Gymnastics together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: The learner appreciates their unique abilities in practising the side roll and crab balance.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: The learner follows simple instructions while performing a crab balance and side roll

in gymnastics.

17

Values:
• Love: The learner takes turn to support a peer during performance of the crab balance and side roll.

• Responsibility: The learner puts into practise the aspects of safety of self and others when performing the rolls and balances.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety: The learner observes safety of self and others as they perform the rolls and balances.

• Social cohesion: The learner works in pairs to perform the side roll and crab balance.

Link to other learning areas:

Mathematics: The learner uses number and sequence concepts in performing gymnastics.
